title: Covariance-aware blood-count dysregulation: an exploratory cross-survey incremental prediction test
abstract: Adding covariance-aware blood-count distance changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.175328 to 0.175378 (delta +0.000050; approximate joint PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000172,+0.000569]); improvement was not established under the registered criterion. NHANES III to separately recruited NHANES2017–2018; exploratory representation test on previously explored surveys, not untouched confirmation.
